questions.stem: What is the primary function of an assembler in compiler design?

choices.A: Compiles high-level code into machine code
choices.C: Translates source code into assembly language
choices.D: Optimizes machine code for better performance

questions.solution: An assembler translates assembly language instructions into machine code. It is responsible for interpreting the assembly language and generating the corresponding binary code.
questions.explanation: Option A refers to a compiler, option C refers to a parser or lexical analyzer, and option D refers to an optimizer  – all of which are different components in a compiler system.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is selecting A (compiler) instead of B (assembler), as some learners may混淆 the roles of these two components.

questions.stem: Which component of a compiler takes source code and generates an abstract syntax tree  (AST)?
questions.solution: A parser is responsible for taking the source code and breaking it down into an abstract syntax tree, which represents the structure of the program.
questions.explanation: Option A  (Scanner) lexically analyzes the input, option C  (Code generator) translates the AST into machine code, and option D  (Optimizer) improves the generated code' efficiency.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is selecting A (scanner), as learners might confuse tokenization with parsing.

questions.stem: What does a scanner in compiler design do?

choices.A: Generates an abstract syntax tree from source code
choices.B: Translates assembly language into machine code
choices.C: Splits input source code into tokens

questions.solution: A scanner reads the input source code and breaks it down into a sequence of meaningful symbols or tokens.
questions.explanation: Option A refers to a parser, option B refers to an assembler, and option D refers to an optimizer  – all of which are different components in a compiler system.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is selecting A (parser), as learners might混淆the roles of these two components.

questions.stem: What does the code generator do in a compiler?

choices.A: Analyzes the source code' s syntax and semantics
choices.B: Translates tokens into an abstract syntax tree
choices.C: Generates machine code from the abstract syntax tree
choices.D: Optimizes the high-level language for better performance

questions.solution: The code generator takes the abstract syntax tree generated by the parser and translates it into machine code that can be executed by a computer.

questions.stem: What is the primary role of an optimizer in a compiler?

choices.A: Converts source code into assembly language
choices.B: Reads and processes input tokens from source code
choices.C: Generates machine code from an abstract syntax tree
choices.D: Improves the efficiency of the generated machine code

questions.solution: The optimizer analyzes the machine code generated by the code generator and applies various techniques to improve its performance, such as eliminating redundant operations or rearranging instructions.
questions.explanation: Option A refers to a lexical analyzer, option B refers to a scanner, and option C refers to a code generator  – all of which are different components in a compiler system.

questions.stem: Which component of a compiler checks the source code' s syntax for correctness?
questions.solution: The parser is responsible for analyzing the source code' s syntax and ensuring it follows the rules of the programming language.
questions.explanation: Option A  (Scanner) only tokenizes the input, option C  (Code generator) generates machine code, and option D  (Optimizer) focuses on improving performance  – none of which check syntax directly.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is selecting A (scanner), as learners might混淆tokenization with syntax analysis.

questions.stem: What does the semantic analyzer do in a compiler?

choices.A: Breaks down source code into tokens
choices.B: Generates an abstract syntax tree from input tokens
choices.C: Verifies that the meaning of the program is correct
choices.D: Translates the abstract syntax tree into machine code

questions.solution: The semantic analyzer checks the meaning of the source code, ensuring type correctness, scope resolution, and other aspects related to the language' s semantics.
